cells.gaps: No row states whether implementing regulations under law 2008-12 are issued or not; regulations is empty. A replacement bill is reported as drafting or in the circuit, with no stage given.
cells.note: Restaged under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (stage 5 needs no regulation): Law 2008-12 is in force (SEN-003) and the CDP's quarterly reports count files, authorisations and complaints handled (SEN-001, April-June 2026; SEN-021, fourth quarter 2025), so stage 5; SEN-014 (named controller notice, 2024-04-20) is applied. Whether regulations exist under the law no longer bars it.
